description: This Java class 'WidgetContextCacheKey' provides a way to generate cache keys based on widget context maps, with custom equality and string representation methods that ignore certain fields.

classes.name: WidgetContextCacheKey
classes.description: A final class that encapsulates a widget context map to be used as a cache key, with custom equality and string representation logic.

methods.name: WidgetContextCacheKey
methods.description: Constructor that creates an unmodifiable copy of the provided context map.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a constant hash code (0), which is unconventional and may affect performance in hash-based collections.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Custom equality method that compares context maps, ignoring specific fields and handling 'parameters' separately.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the context map, excluding certain fields and including 'parameters'.
